# Source of ground_tiles.aseprite and ground_tiles.png (python tools/sprite/sprite.py build <this> ground_tiles.aseprite).
# Ground pieces for green_land_tile_set (source 2), placed by tools/level_tiles.py ground: block b = terrain
# (0 grass, 1 less green, 2 pale sand, 3 sand, 4 red, 5 bog), 8x8 tiles each; tile (b*8 + (mask%4)*2 + x%2,
# (mask//4)*2 + y%2), mask 1 N, 2 E, 4 S, 8 W = that neighbour is the same terrain. Open sides are wavy, open
# corners round, sand gets a light grass rim; the speckle repeats every 32 px with no lines at tile edges.
# Bog (block 5) lies lower than the grass: a dark green bank, the north and west inner edge in shadow.
size = 768x128
a = 2f6b3d
b = 323a26
c = 3a3b24
d = 439148
e = 45472a
f = 56602f
g = 568239
h = 63c74d
i = bc6e48
j = cdb99a
k = dacab7
l = e4a672
m = e8b796
